Intra-Body Joint-Angle Co-Modulation Viewer

Interactive playback of marker-less pose estimates. From 17 keypoints it derives 13 joint signals and their time-frequency relationships. Choose an example to begin, or open your own file. Everything is computed in your browser; no data leaves this page.

This tool does not read video. Analyse your video first with DeepLabCut, then open the .csv it writes. See the README.

Example datasets are 120-second display excerpts at the native 60 fps. The article and the README describe the study and the data.
Opening a file computes every wavelet transform up front, so it is not instant: ten to fifteen seconds for a 120-second excerpt, and about two minutes for a full fifteen-minute session. The wait is reported while it happens, with the time still to go.
